**Easiest install, in PowerShell:**

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/navasshereef1/PromptPilot/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Or download `PromptPilot.exe` below and run it. Requires Windows 10 or 11. The app isn't code-signed yet, so a direct download may show a Windows warning: choose **More info > Run anyway**. You'll need a free API key, which the app helps you get.

This file was built by GitHub from the public source code. To verify it:

```bash
gh attestation verify PromptPilot.exe --repo navasshereef1/PromptPilot
```

See the [changelog](https://github.com/navasshereef1/PromptPilot/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) and [privacy notes](https://github.com/navasshereef1/PromptPilot/blob/main/PRIVACY.md). If it saves you time, you can [buy me a coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/navas1).
